newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Hellaby still on acquisition trail.
newsitem.headline: Hellaby still on acquisition trail.

text.p: New Zealand investment company Hellaby Holdings said on Monday it would continue to seek further acquisition opportunities.
The company said its financial position remained very healthy, and strong cash flow from operating activities was expected to continue.
"Whilst the economy in general has eased, this is not expected to adversely affect Hellaby Holdings' overall performance," the company said in a statement.
Earlier, it reported net profit for the six months to December of NZ$6.28 million, compared with $6.22 million a year earlier.
